hypothesis: The exact v51 HYPE compression-pullback route may translate its development edge into repeatable after-cost live outcomes, while any relaxed-entry or profit-lock challenger must outperform the frozen control without relying on its largest winner.
decision: Continue the exact v51 live route unchanged. Close the already-tested missing-onset relaxation and generic completed-bar profit-lock families as research directions. Do not remove the canonical breakout-onset requirement and do not add a profit lock. A future challenger must declare a genuinely new causal mechanism identity and retain untouched forward evaluation.
falsifier: The no-change decision should be updated if exact v51 live lifecycles become negative after realized costs across a predeclared window, or if a separately versioned causal mechanism remains positive across chronological development and untouched forward evidence, on both supported sides, and after removing its largest winner.

entry_conditions: fresh completed 5m canonical BREAKOUT onset with structural side
completed 5m BBWP percentile at or below 50
prior 15-minute minimum 1m BBWP at or below 40
directional signal-bar body at or below 0 bps

recommendation.recommendation: Keep the exact v51 HYPE route running while directing new research away from already-falsified gate relaxation and generic profit locks.
recommendation.why_now: The active monitor still ranked signal-cost diagnosis even though development, later confirmation, first-window counterfactuals, and three profit-lock families already answer that question.
evidence_reviewed: frozen HYPE compression development and later-confirmation report
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The route has no v51 eligible entry yet; relaxing the missing onset is adverse after estimated friction, while prior profitability is fold-unstable and largest-winner dependent.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: Fresh completed 5m BREAKOUT onsets emerging from recent 5m and 1m volatility compression, entered only on a non-chasing directional pullback bar.
alternatives_considered: add one of three generic profit locks
continue the exact route and require a new mechanism identity for further research
recommendation.expected_upside: Avoids paying friction on adverse missing-onset paths and avoids replacing the control exit with historically inferior profit locks while preserving the live translation test.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: The exact route can remain too sparse or lose live; the development result is fold-unstable; the four-trade confirmation is concentrated; counterfactual BBO paths are not fills.
recommendation.validation_completed: Chronological fold review, realistic fee/funding/slippage replay, later confirmation, largest-winner sensitivity, three profit-lock comparisons, and first-window route readiness/counterfactual review.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Exact v51 long and short fills and resolved lifecycles with actual fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, excursions, and non-adjacent forward-window stability.
recommendation.success_metrics: Positive after-cost live net and profit factor above one combined and by supported side, positive without the largest winner, no technical suppression, and exact execution-plan parity.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: A technical route mismatch or unprotected position is an incident; negative compatible live economics across a predeclared window triggers reconsideration of the exact route; no research result changes live authority automatically.
recommendation.confidence_level: high for closing the tested relaxations; low for durable live profitability

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue passive HYPE live translation collection; direct active research to the next unresolved route rather than reopening threshold relaxation or generic profit-lock families.
limitations: The first v51 window contains no eligible signal or completed lifecycle.
Readiness counterfactuals use estimated adverse BBO friction and are not orders or fills.
Development threshold selection was post-hoc and only two of five folds were positive.
Later confirmation has only four trades and becomes negative without its largest winner.
No live strategy, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, or authority changed from this decision.
